scope: Official public EMA/HMPC and ESCOP monograph summaries.
governance_note: WHO item-level expansion was deliberately deferred in this pass because individual monograph locators were not verified to the same standard. No WHO plant record was inferred from collection-level metadata.
source_policy: Only facts visible on official public source pages are represented. Curator summaries are paraphrases and not verbatim quotations.

records.curator_summary: EMA identifies marshmallow root as the dried root of Althaea officinalis and lists mouth/throat, cough/cold, and gastrointestinal therapeutic areas.

records.source_title: Hederae helicis folium - herbal medicinal product
records.curator_summary: EMA lists ivy leaf from Hedera helix under cough and cold and provides a final EU herbal monograph revision.

records.botanical_name: Thymus vulgaris L.; Thymus zygis L.
records.curator_summary: EMA lists thyme herb from Thymus vulgaris or Thymus zygis in the cough-and-cold therapeutic area.

records.botanical_name: Urtica dioica L.; Urtica urens L.
records.curator_summary: EMA lists nettle root from Urtica dioica or Urtica urens for urinary-tract/genital therapeutic use and provides a final revised EU herbal monograph.

records.source_title: Foeniculi dulcis fructus - herbal medicinal product
records.botanical_name: Foeniculum vulgare subsp. vulgare var. dulce
records.outcome: European Union herbal monograph and European Union list entry
records.curator_summary: EMA's public summary describes traditional oral use of sweet fennel fruit for mild spasmodic GI complaints, minor menstrual cramps, and as an expectorant in cough associated with colds.

records.source_title: Plantaginis ovatae seminis tegumentum - herbal medicinal product
records.curator_summary: EMA identifies ispaghula husk as the seed coats of Plantago ovata and describes oral herbal medicines made from the husk or its powder.

records.botanical_name: Urtica dioica L.; Urtica urens L.
therapeutic_scope: symptomatic micturition disorders in benign prostatic hyperplasia
records.curator_summary: ESCOP defines nettle root as underground parts of Urtica dioica/Urtica urens and lists symptomatic micturition disorders in BPH as the therapeutic indication.
ESCOP defines melissa leaf as dried leaves of Melissa officinalis and lists CNS, digestive, and herpes-labialis therapeutic indications.
ESCOP lists tension, restlessness, irritability and difficulty falling asleep among therapeutic indications of Passiflora incarnata herb.

therapeutic_scope: minor gastrointestinal spasms and related complaints
minor inflammation and irritation of skin and mucosa
records.curator_summary: ESCOP defines Matricaria flower as dried capitula and distinguishes internal gastrointestinal indications from external skin/mucosal uses.

records.botanical_name: Salix spp. including S. purpurea L., S. daphnoides Vill. and S. fragilis L.
records.curator_summary: ESCOP lists low-back pain, mild rheumatic conditions, fever with common cold, and headache among willow-bark indications.

therapeutic_scope: symptomatic digestive disorders including dyspepsia, flatulence and gastritis
records.curator_summary: ESCOP defines peppermint leaf as dried Mentha × piperita leaves and lists symptomatic digestive disorders including dyspepsia, flatulence and gastritis.
